content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Outsources HR and benefits administration to large employers, a different business from healthcare billing and provider software."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Sells HCM and payroll software to small and mid-sized employers, not healthcare provider software or billing."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Sells donor, fundraising and education software to nonprofits and schools, a different customer and product set."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Provides telecom and pay-TV billing and customer care software to operators, unrelated to provider revenue cycle."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Earns most revenue from pharma marketing and trial recruitment, not from software or billing for providers."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Sells customer engagement and knowledge software to enterprise service operations, not healthcare provider workflows."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Serves small service businesses across many verticals with payments and scheduling, not provider billing and EHR."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Sells healthcare workforce, learning and survey software to hospitals, lacking the EHR, practice management and billing business."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Sells patient experience and employee surveys with benchmarking, a research and analytics business rather than billing or EHR."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Sells US HCM and payroll software to employers, a different business from healthcare practice software and billing."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Sells cloud payroll and HR software to mid-sized employers, not healthcare provider software or revenue cycle services."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Provides contracted physician staffing and bills payers for care; its revenue cycle is a side service, not a software and billing business."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Mainly manufactures medical and dental products, with coding and documentation as smaller lines, so the business mix differs."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"Sells enterprise social media and customer experience software across industries, not provider EHR or billing."},{"label":"C15","good":true,"reason":"Sells EHR, revenue cycle and patient engagement software plus outsourced billing to hospitals, matching the target's business."},{"label":"C16","good":false,"reason":"Sells work management and content software to enterprises and government, unrelated to healthcare provider billing."},{"label":"C17","good":false,"reason":"Sells cloud applications to life sciences companies for commercial and regulatory operations, not to healthcare providers."}]}
